slides.texte_overlay:
toxic study motivation
that works a little TOO well

the version of you who passes this test
is already sitting at this desk.
she's just waiting for you to open the notes.

"i'll just reread it"
rereading feels like studying. it is NOT.
you're just recognizing words.

test yourself before you feel ready.
finding out you know 4/10 today is free.
finding out on the test is not.

future you is going to read this grade.
do you really want to explain to her
why you didn't start?

you scrolled for 40 minutes and felt nothing.
imagine giving those 40 minutes to ONE chapter.

you don't need to feel motivated.
you need to open the notes. the feeling shows up after.

the only person you're competing with
is who you were LAST semester.
